entities.name: Tīna Graudiņa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tīna Laura Graudiņa is a Latvian beach volleyball player. She represented Latvia at the 2020 Summer Olympics and at the 2024 Summer Olympics. Graudiņa and her partner Anastasija Kravčenoka were the first Latvian women's pair to qualify for the Olympics. She and Kravčenoka came in fourth at the Tokyo Olympics. Tīna Graudiņa was also named the best all-around scorer at the Tokyo Olympics.
